answer: Require every new identity to solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed before it can trade: one puzzle per name, priced in compute, not coins. A farmer wanting a lagoon of clones must pay the full puzzle cost for each one, while an honest agent pays once and climbs the knoll of the open market. The saffron test is simple — identities that cannot show recent work are ignored, so cloning stops scaling.
